data.name: Twell
data.detailed_description:
You wake up in a mysterious world called Twell with no memory of who you are or how you got there. With nothing but your curiosity to guide you, it's up to you to explore this world. Complete 8 unique dungeons, discover hidden secrets, and visit a variety of populated locations.

Twell is an adventure game built in RPG Maker XP, featuring a variety of puzzles, exploration, and a simple action-based battle system.

The game is designed to keep you engaged without overwhelming you with endless dialogue or repetitive grinding. Instead, your journey is about exploration, discovery, puzzles, and challenges with plenty of secrets waiting for those who take the time to look for them.

If you enjoy classic RPG adventures with a focus on exploration and mystery, Twell offers a world full of secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Why is it free?

Creating Twell has been a passion project, and more than anything, I hope that you will play it, explore its world, and have a great time. 

- Every dungeon has unique puzzles, enemies, bosses and theme.

- Use key items to solve puzzles and uncover new areas.

- The look of the character depends on which equipment you wear.

- Visit many locations with unique characters to interact with.

- Choose which type of sword you want and which skills you want to learn.

- Side quests are available to you at the start, solve them whenever you want.

- Feel free to play the game in your own order. No hand-holding, but it's clear where to go next.

- The game keeps your progress when it's game over, simply choose a location to continue.

- You can unlock extra challenges for Battle Mode.

- You can also start the game on hard difficulty for some extra challenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® XP/20
  • Processor: PC with 800MHz Intel® Pentium® III equivalent or higher processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1024x768 or better video resolution in High Color mode
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card
